final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms / (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM per_type) AS ratio_to_avg FROM per_type
